title: The balanced scorecard
caption: Four perspectives balance the financial view with customers, processes and people. In a hospital trust each holds its own measures, and together they show whether strategy is being delivered.
alt: Four boxes: financial, customer, internal business process, and learning and growth, each with the hospital trust's measures.
description: Financial: staying within budget, cost per patient episode.
Internal processes: infection rates, bed occupancy, discharge before midday.
Learning and growth: staff training completed, staff vacancy rates.
